F.name: C light + A dark, cosmic background
F.note: Light theme from option C, dark theme from option A. An even, faded cosmic wash behind the whole workspace (not the sidebar); a stronger, slowly moving one on the login screen; flowing lines of light for live voice.

light.cosmos: radial-gradient(38% 42% at 24% 28%, #7fb2ff99, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(36% 40% at 78% 22%, #6fe0d080, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 44% at 66% 80%, #a9b8ff99, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(34% 38% at 18% 82%, #ffd0a880, transparent 70%)

dark.glow: radial-gradient(70% 55% at 50% 40%, #5b8cff26, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(45% 40% at 80% 15%, #3fd0c016, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 40% at 15% 88%, #8f9bff18, transparent 70%)
dark.cosmos: radial-gradient(38% 42% at 24% 28%, #3b6cf070, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(36% 40% at 78% 22%, #19c5b050, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 44% at 66% 80%, #7c8cf060, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(34% 38% at 18% 82%, #f0a25a38, transparent 70%)
